mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of potassium and reduces creatinine clearance, while torsemide causes potassium wasting, creating opposing effects on serum potassium with unpredictable net result and reduced diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged trimethoprim use is needed; adjust torsemide dosing if necessary.
